text: A proposed cash-and-stock transaction introduces a new controlling structure, board composition, and listing venue onto UMG. Existing ownership, governance, and listing configurations remain concurrently present. Pricing reflects a large premium relative to prior market valuation. Structural control surfaces (board, listing, equity composition) are simultaneously defined by both current and proposed states.

meta.note: Contest and alignment operate simultaneously across different structural layers.

text: Used vehicle prices and demand remain elevated while available inventory stays low. Wholesale index levels exceed prior periods as supply duration compresses below typical thresholds. Consumer substitution toward used vehicles persists alongside constrained inflow from new vehicle trade-ins. Price formation and demand remain structurally synchronized within limited supply conditions.

meta.note: Compression and continuity operate together without observable release or expansion.
